request.description: Phase 8 — Liveness probe. Returns 200 when the API process is running. Used by container orchestrators (Kubernetes) to determine if the container should be restarted.
Phase 8 — Readiness probe. Returns 200 when the API can serve traffic (database reachable). Used by container orchestrators to control traffic routing.
Phase 8 — Verify OWASP security headers are present in every response: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, Content-Security-Policy.
Phase 8 — When a client provides X-Correlation-Id, the same value must be echoed back in the response header.
Phase 8 — When no X-Correlation-Id is sent, the server generates one and returns it in X-Correlation-Id response header. Verify the header is present.
Phase 8 — Unauthenticated requests to protected endpoints must return 401 Unauthorized.
Phase 8 — Unauthenticated requests to guest endpoints must return 401 Unauthorized.

Phase 8 — IDOR protection test. A user authenticated for org A must not be able to read org B data. Expected: 403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found.

Set {{anotherOrgId}} to a valid org ID that belongs to a different organization than the authenticated user.
Phase 8 — IDOR protection. Authenticated as Org A, attempt to read a property that belongs to Org B. Must return 403 or 404.

item.name: Rate Limit — Auth Endpoint (429 after limit)

request.description: Phase 8 — Rate limiting. Auth endpoints are limited to 20 requests/minute per IP. After exceeding the limit, subsequent requests return 429 Too Many Requests. This request demonstrates the endpoint; use a runner or script to hit the limit in testing.
